_comment: Worked example. Maps screen keys to Figma frames for the design audit (docs/design-audit.md). Run scripts/save-figma-screenshots.js --figma-url=<https://www.figma.com/design/<FILE_KEY>/<file-name>> to export the frames. Map the FINAL animation frame of each screen (isFinalFrame: true).
